RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the August 8, 2003/Sravana 17, 1925 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Environment and Forests;
Food Processing Industries; Human Resource Development;
Ocean Development; Railways; Science and Technology;
Steel; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions—20
Joint venture of KIOCL
*281. SHRI MURLI DEORA: Will the
Minister of STEEL be pleased to state:
(a) what are the names of the products
currently being manufactured by a Joint
Venture Company floated by Kudremukh
Iron Ore Co. Ltd. (KIOCL) alongwith two
other public sector undertakings in
June, 1995;
(b) the contribution to equity made by
KIOCL to Joint Venture Co. and the
reasons for non-allotment of shares;
(c) the amount of loan granted and the
interest realised; and
(d) the reasons for grant of
concessional loan and the loss caused in
interest thereof?
Expansion of area under bamboo
*282. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
announced any scheme to expand the area
under bamboo;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government propose to
encourage State Governments to grow
bamboo in degraded lands under their
control; if so, the details thereof; and
(d) whether Government propose to
give any assistance to State Governments
for this purpose; if so, the details thereof?
Improvement in GER for boys and
girls in Orissa
*283. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of children (boys and
girls separately) in age group of 6 to 14
years, who go to school in Orissa;
(b) what are the latest figures for Gross
Enrollment Ratio (GER) and dropout ratio
for boys and girls at primary level in Orissa;
and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
improve the GER especially for girls in
Orissa?

84
Technical Education Quality and
Improvement Programme
*284. SHRI V.V. RAGHAVAN:
SHRI GAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are implementing a Technical Education
Quality and Improvement Programme
(TEQIP) with the help of some
international agencies; and
(b) if so, the details of the programme?
Foot and Mouth Disease Eradication
Project
*285. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether any request from Andhra
Pradesh Government has been received to
include Mahboob Nagar and Nizamabad
districts in the National Programme for Foot
and Mouth Disease Eradication Project;
(b) if so, when such a request was
received; and
(c) what action Government have taken
on the request?
Vacant posts in Kendriya Vidyalayas
†*286. SHRI GHANSHYAM
CHANDRA KHARWAR: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the region-wise, subject-wise and
post-wise details of vacant posts in Kendriya
Vidyalayas as on 30th June, 2003; and
(b) by when these posts will be filled up?
Bio-farm in Orissa
*287. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it has been impressed upon
Orissa to set up a bio-farm in the State;
(b) if so, whether the State has asked
for help in the matter from the Centre; if
so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether bio-farms growing
medicinal plants, have been set up in any
of the States/areas; if so, the details thereof?
Efficiency in Railways
†*288. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a dialogue with the
Railways personnel has been held directly
to improve the efficiency in Railways and
to stop rail accidents so that the deficiencies
could be removed;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of other steps being taken
to remove the deficiencies?
Accreditation of Technical and
Educational Institutions
*289. SHRI PREM CHAND GUPTA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that as per the
report of the Comptroller and Auditor
General (CAG) on the state of our

none of the 171 Institutes audited by them
could fulfil the AICTE requirements

(b) if so, what are the reasons therefor?
Safety on Railways
†*290. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE:
SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have so far
implemented any important recommen-
dations on railway safety made by the
Khanna Committee and Rakesh Mohan
Committee;
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor; and
(c) steps taken to implement the
recommendations of those two Committees
to prevent frequent recurrence of rail
accidents which have shown

Reducing edible oil imports
2078. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether edible oil imports are
projected to hit well over the 41 per cent
mark which reached in 2001-2002;
(b) whether edible oil imports is likely
to rise more than the last year;
(c) if so, the total edible oil imports made
during the last year;
(d) to what extent it will be more during
the current year;
(e) whether the Ministry had opposed a
reduction of duty on imported palm oil and
palmolein by the Finance Ministry; and
(f) by when the efforts would be made
to see that the production of edible oil in the
country is improved, so that imports are
reduced?
Formulating national livestock policy
2079. SHRI MOOLCHAND MEENA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether alarmed at the decline in fund
allocation for animal husbandry and fishery,
the Centre and the States have favoured quick
formulation of a National Livestock Policy
to step up investment, check cheap imports
and protect farmers' interests under WTO
regime;
(b) if so, whether the State Ministers'
Conference on animal husbandry was held
in February, 2003;
(c) if so, what were the main points
discussed; and
(d) what were the decisions taken?
Drought relief in Rajasthan through
NGOs
2080. SHRI AIMADUDDIN AHMAD
KHAN (DURRU): Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether large number of voluntary
organisations and other NGOs from foreign
countries had come to Rajasthan recently
for the distribution of drought relief to BPL
families;
(b) if so, the details in this regard
indicating the names of those foreign
voluntary organisations and NGOs who
had visited Rajasthan alongwith the places
where they had visited and the nature of
drought relief that had been distributed; and
(c) how far such drought relief had
helped to redress the problems of the drought
affected people of Rajasthan?

456
Depletion of livestock
†2081. SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
livestock in the country is depleting
continuously;
(b) if so, whether Government are
contemplating to formulate a policy or enact
a stringent law in order to protect livestock;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Ban on use of endosulfan on
plantation crops
2082. SHRI H.K. JAVARE GOWDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that endosulfan
has been classified as 'highly hazardous' to
health and banned in many countries;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
endosulfan is still being used in the
country particularly in Karnataka and
Kerala on cashew plantations and has
been linked to hundreds of cases of birth
defects, psychiatric illness, cancer etc.;
and
(c) whether Government propose to ban
the use of endosulfan on plantation crops in
the country; if so, the details thereof?
Effectiveness of Jalkumbhi compost
†2083. SHRIMATI SAROJ DUBEY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that compost made
of 'Jalkumbhi' a typical water plant is more
effective than manure for enhancing
agricultural yield;
(b) if so, whether Government are going
to take any step to promote its use; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Effect of pre-monsoon rains on kharif
crops
2084. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
SHRI R.S. GAVAI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the below normal rains in
the pre-monsoon season and the delay in
the onset of South-West monsoon had
affected sowing of early kharif cereals and
rice;
(b) if so, whether this would have any
adverse impact on production of these grains;
and
(c) if so, the likely fall in the production
of these grains?
Development of Agriculture in Arid
Zones
2085. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) what are the arid zones in various
States;
(b) the scheme presently being
implemented for the development of
agriculture in those arid zones; and
(c) the details of allocation made to
various States during the last three years for
the development of agriculture in those arid
zones?
